mapper.select: SELECT a.*,a.hospital_site as hospitalsite, a.hospital_doctor_site as hospital_site FROM hospital_bedoc_list as a WHERE 1=1 and is_crawling_done = false and hospital_site != '' and hospital_site is not null ORDER BY a.hospital_cid ASC LIMIT 10
mapper.update: UPDATE hospital_bedoc_list set is_site_ok = #{isOk}, site_check_date = NOW() WHERE hospital_cid = #{cid}
